description: On a nonempty well-ordered linear order, no family of total recursion rules can have the empty type as its value type.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.recursion_empty_values_impossible.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] [Nonempty α] :
